incoterms.disclaimer: These summaries are for general guidance only. Confirm the contractual interpretation of any Incoterm with your legal and commercial advisors before shipment.
incoterms.EXW: Ex Works — the buyer collects from the seller's premises and bears all onward cost and risk.
incoterms.FCA: Free Carrier — the seller delivers to a carrier nominated by the buyer at a named place.
incoterms.FOB: Free On Board — the seller delivers the goods on board the vessel at the named port of shipment.
incoterms.CFR: Cost and Freight — the seller pays carriage to the destination port; risk passes on loading.
incoterms.CIF: Cost, Insurance and Freight — as CFR, with the seller also providing minimum cargo insurance.
incoterms.CPT: Carriage Paid To — the seller pays carriage to the named destination; risk passes at first carrier.
incoterms.CIP: Carriage and Insurance Paid To — as CPT, with the seller also providing cargo insurance.
incoterms.DAP: Delivered At Place — the seller delivers ready for unloading at the named destination.
incoterms.DPU: Delivered At Place Unloaded — the seller delivers and unloads at the named destination.
incoterms.DDP: Delivered Duty Paid — the seller bears all cost and risk including import duties.
